title: Responsive Single-Page Personal Portfolio
description: Create a clean, mobile-responsive single-page website showcasing your bio, education, current learning goals, and contact links.
acceptanceCriteria: Page contains semantic header, about, skills, and contact sections using HTML5 tags.
Layout is fully responsive across smartphone (375px) and laptop (1200px) screens with no horizontal overflow.
Uses CSS Flexbox or Grid for layout alignment and includes at least one hover effect.
Code is organized into index.html and style.css files.

title: Bhopal Local Services Showcase
description: Build an interactive card-based showcase for local businesses in Bhopal (e.g. local repair shops, cafes, coaching centers) with category filtering and search.
acceptanceCriteria: Displays at least 6 local business cards with title, category, address/neighborhood, and badge.
Includes a search input that filters cards in real-time as the user types.
Includes category pill buttons (e.g., Food, Services, Education) that filter cards via JavaScript.
Gracefully shows an empty state message if no matching businesses are found.

title: Interactive Daily Expense Tracker
description: Build a client-side daily expense tracker where learners can add income and expenses, view balance updates, and persist transactions using browser localStorage.
acceptanceCriteria: User can input transaction description, amount, and type (income vs expense).
Current balance, total income, and total expense calculate and update dynamically.
Transactions are saved in localStorage so refreshing the page preserves the data.
User can delete a transaction from the list.

title: Tier-2 Weather & Air Quality Dashboard
description: Fetch live weather data for cities (defaults to Bhopal/Indore) using a free weather API (Open-Meteo or OpenWeather) with async/await and error handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Fetches real-time temperature, wind speed, and weather condition using fetch() and async/await.
Shows a loading spinner while API request is in-flight.
Gracefully handles network errors or invalid city names with user-friendly error banners.
Pre-populates quick buttons for Bhopal, Indore, Jabalpur, and Gwalior.

title: React Daily Habit & Study Routine Tracker
description: A component-based React application to track daily learning habits, study hours, and weekly streaks with clean state management.
acceptanceCriteria: Decomposed into reusable React components (HabitCard, StreakCounter, AddHabitModal).
Uses React state (useState) and side effects (useEffect) to store habits in browser storage.
Allows toggling daily completion status with visual feedback.
Responsive on mobile screens.

title: RESTful Study Notes & Resource API
description: Build a secure REST API with Express and MongoDB Mongoose that allows learners to store, search, and categorize their study notes with full CRUD operations.
acceptanceCriteria: Implements GET /api/notes, POST /api/notes, PUT /api/notes/:id, DELETE /api/notes/:id.
Validates request payloads using Zod or Mongoose schema validators.
Properly handles 400 Bad Request, 404 Not Found, and 500 Internal Error codes with JSON responses.
Includes a sample seed script or Postman/Thunder Client collection demonstrating all endpoints.
